page: Microsoft Azure HB176-24rs_v4 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the HBv4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This server features 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 32.0 GB per core.

For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 4332 GB NVMe SSD. The server is RDMA capable, which supports low-latency, high-throughput networking configurations. Additionally, it is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-speed external storage options.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:32 and the inclusion of a large local NVMe SSD, this server offers resource density optimized for memory-intensive and data-heavy workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention. This profile is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, memory-intensive simulations, in-memory analytics, and high-performance computing tasks requiring RDMA networking.
